description: Get line price chart data for a specific market Returns time-series price data suitable for charting line movement. To chart one participant, first discover its public `participant_id` with `GET /api/v2/markets/participants` for the same event and market, then pass that value here. For totals (market `3`), discover the `TYPE_RESULT` Over and Under participants and request each side separately. Series are grouped by affiliate and can otherwise contain points for more than one participant. `main_line=true` keeps only the points that were the main line when written. Read-only Product data or price calculation. Use returned canonical IDs. Access, delay and metered usage follow your connected account; never infer coverage from an empty result. One bounded request, no background polling or automatic retry. Affiliate 27 is excluded. No wagers, account changes or guarantee of returns.

eventID.description: Canonical V2 event ID from the `event_id` field returned by event endpoints

affiliate_ids.description:
Comma-separated sportsbook/affiliate IDs to filter. Common values include DraftKings (19), FanDuel (23), BetMGM (22), BookMaker (7), BetCRIS (9), Pinnacle (3), Polymarket US (31), Circa Sports (32), Bet105 (33), and Heritage Sports (34). Availability varies by sport and market.
On V2 event endpoints (`/api/v2/sports/{sportID}/events/{date}`, `/api/v2/events/{eventID}`, and their openers/closing siblings), `affiliate_ids=0` is a scores-only sentinel: the response keeps events, scores, and status and omits markets and price objects. Other endpoints that share this parameter treat `affiliate_ids` as a sportsbook filter only.
 Comma-separated integer IDs; maximum 10, unique, no spaces or encoded aliases. Affiliate 27 is excluded.

limit.description: Maximum total points across all returned sportsbooks. Invalid or out-of-range values use 1000.

main_line.description: When `true`, return only history rows (or chart points) that were the sportsbook's main line when written — `is_main_line` = true on history rows, `m` = true on chart points. Sorted by time, each change of the line value for a participant is a main-line move at that timestamp.

participant_id.description: Filter by the public canonical `participant_id` returned by `GET /api/v2/markets/participants` for this event and market. For totals (market `3`), use the discovered `TYPE_RESULT` Over or Under participant ID; do not substitute the participant record `id`.

name: v2GetMarketLineHistoryByEvent
title: Get line price chart data for a specific market
